Demand of Input Tax confirmed amounting to ₹ 37,48,073/- in IGST under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017, on account of excess availment of ITC in GSTR-3B as compared to ITC reflected in GSTR-2A, along with interest under Section 50 of the Act and penalty equivalent to the tax amount under Section 122(2)(b) of the CGST Act, for the period from FY 2018–19 to FY 2023–24. 4. timeline.summary: 2026-05-14: Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Bhageria Rare Earth Minerals Private Limited with ₹1 lakh authorised capital, yet to commence business.
On 16th May 2026, Bhageria Industries reported that SAT adjourned the appeal against the SEBI adjudication order to July 2026, extending the stay.
2026-05-25: Wholly owned subsidiary Rahuri Cleantech commissioned a 7 MW solar PV plant at Khanapur, Maharashtra, part of a 32 MW MSKVY 2.0 programme.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹455.7 Cr (+123.0% YoY), net profit ₹55.75 Cr (+386.1% YoY).
